candidate.user_submission: The child is 18 months old and has fever. This fever has lasted for 2 days. The measured temperature is 38.5°C. The setting is high malaria risk. Malaria test was available and the result is negative. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. The child does not have generalized rash. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever. There is no obvious cause of fever seen. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have any ear problem. The child does not have red eyes or runny nose. The child does not have stiff neck. No history of measles within the last 3 months and no cough with measles.
